synopsis: Lewis Cocking is the Conservative MP for Broxbourne, and has been an MP continually since 4 July 2024. He currently undertakes the roles of Shadow Parliamentary Under Secretary (Housing, Communities and Local Government), and Opposition Whip (Commons).
